chapters.title: Getting around
chapters.summary: The menu, search, your region, account, favourites and cart — and what's on the home page.

steps.title: The main menu
steps.body: The logo always takes you back home. Use the menu to open Explore (every wallpaper), Collections (themed sets), Studio and Pricing.

steps.title: Search
steps.body: Type a mood, colour or subject — for example “gold”, “mountains” or “minimal” — and press Enter to see matching wallpapers.

steps.title: Your region and prices
steps.body: Prices are shown for the country you are in. At checkout we also look at your billing country, and after your first purchase prices follow your account.

steps.title: Account, favourites and cart
steps.body: The person icon opens sign-in or your account, the heart opens wallpapers you saved, and the bag opens your cart.

steps.title: Start exploring
steps.body: The big button on the home page takes you straight to every wallpaper, with filters for your device.

steps.title: Today's free wallpaper
steps.body: Every day one premium wallpaper is free until midnight (India time). Sign in and press the button — it stays in your library for good.

steps.title: Browse by category
steps.body: Jump into a category such as Nature, Abstract or Dark AMOLED & Minimal. The number shows how many wallpapers it has.

steps.title: Reading a wallpaper card
steps.body: Each card shows the top resolution (4K or 5K), the category, the price in credits and the shape (landscape or portrait). The heart saves it to Favourites.

steps.title: Help and policies
steps.body: The footer has the Guide, FAQ, contact, all our policies (terms, privacy, refunds, licence) and the page to sell your own art.

chapters.title: Finding the right wallpaper
chapters.summary: Search, sort and filter by category, price, device, orientation and resolution.

steps.title: Search inside Explore
steps.body: Narrow the catalogue with a word. It searches titles, tags and descriptions.

steps.title: Sort
steps.body: Sort by newest, most popular or price.

steps.title: Category and price
steps.body: Tick one or more categories, and choose free or premium wallpapers.

steps.title: Device, orientation and resolution
steps.body: Filter for your phone, tablet or desktop, portrait or landscape, and 4K or 5K. Then press Apply Filters (Reset clears them).

steps.title: Open a wallpaper
steps.body: Click any wallpaper to open its page with the live device preview, sizes and price.

steps.title: Free wallpapers
steps.body: The Free page lists wallpapers you can download without paying (no account needed; downloads are rate-limited).

chapters.title: The wallpaper page
chapters.summary: Preview a wallpaper on your own device, check the sizes, then add it to your cart or save it.

steps.title: Preview on your device
steps.body: The first tab shows the wallpaper on the device you are using right now. Switch to Phone, Tablet, Desktop or the Original image.

steps.title: Lock screen or home screen
steps.body: See it behind the clock (lock screen) or behind your apps (home screen). The preview is small and watermarked — your download is the full-quality file.

steps.title: Try it full screen
steps.body: Opens the preview across your whole screen, so you can see it at real size. A note below tells you if the wallpaper is sharp on your screen.

steps.title: Price and sizes
steps.body: One credit unlocks the wallpaper in every size listed under “Sizes included”. It's marked AI-generated, as all our wallpapers are.

steps.title: Add to cart or save
steps.body: Add to Cart to unlock it with credits at checkout, or Save to keep it in Favourites for later.

steps.title: Commercial licence
steps.body: The normal licence is for personal use. For products, ads or client work add the commercial licence (5 credits). Read the licence terms for details.

steps.title: Details and tags
steps.body: Read the description, the category, largest size and file type. Tap a tag to see similar wallpapers.

steps.title: Related wallpapers
steps.body: More wallpapers in the same style, to keep browsing.

chapters.title: Credits, plans and checkout
chapters.summary: How credits work, which pack or plan to pick, and how to unlock wallpapers at checkout.

steps.title: Credit packs
steps.body: Everything is bought with credits: 1 credit = 1 wallpaper in every size. Bigger packs include bonus credits (valid 12 months); credits you pay for never expire.

steps.title: Plans
steps.body: Prefer a monthly allowance? Pick Monthly, Long-term (3–12 months for less per month), a Category pass, or Business (includes the commercial licence).

steps.title: Add to cart
steps.body: On any wallpaper press Add to Cart. You can keep browsing and add more.

steps.title: Your cart
steps.body: Check what's in your cart and the total in credits, then continue to checkout.

steps.title: Unlock with credits
steps.body: At checkout, confirm and the wallpapers are unlocked with your credits straight away. If you don't have enough credits, we show the packs that cover it.

steps.title: Done — it's in your library
steps.body: Unlocked wallpapers appear in My Library right away, ready to download.

chapters.title: Signing in and your password
chapters.summary: Create an account, sign in with a password or an email link, and reset a forgotten password.

steps.title: Sign in or create an account
steps.body: Switch between Sign in and Create account. New accounts get free welcome credits.

steps.title: Choose a strong password
steps.body: Use at least 10 characters with letters and numbers or symbols. The meter shows how strong it is, and we check that it hasn't appeared in a known data breach.

steps.title: Forgot your password?
steps.body: Press “Forgot password?”, enter your email, and open the link we send to set a new one.

steps.title: Sign in without a password
steps.body: Prefer no password? Ask for a one-time sign-in link by email and open it on the same device.

chapters.title: Your library and account
chapters.summary: Download what you own, see credits and receipts, invite friends, send gifts, get help and manage your settings.

steps.title: My Library
steps.body: Your home after signing in: how many wallpapers you own, downloads used, and your credit balance.

steps.title: Download a size
steps.body: Press a size to download it. Each purchase includes up to 5 downloads, so you can set it up on new devices too. Search, filter by licence and sort the list above.

steps.title: Credits
steps.body: See your balance, bonus credits that expire soon, and the full history of credits added and spent.

steps.title: Orders, receipts and refunds
steps.body: Open a printable receipt for any order. “Get help” starts a support request about that order; unused packs and passes can be refunded right here within the refund window.

steps.title: Invite friends
steps.body: Share your link (or send it on WhatsApp). Your friend gets extra free credits, and you get bonus credits after their first purchase.

steps.title: Gifts
steps.body: Send credits as a gift, see gifts you've sent, or redeem a gift code someone gave you.

steps.title: Help and support
steps.body: Open a new request or follow an existing one. We reply within 48 hours; you'll see our answers here and by email.

steps.title: Settings
steps.body: Edit your name, country and GSTIN (for GST invoices), change your email and password, and sign out of every device.

steps.title: Your data and closing your account
steps.body: Download a copy of your data at any time. Closing your account is permanent: unused credits are lost, and orders are kept only as tax law requires.

chapters.title: Selling your art
chapters.summary: Become a creator, upload wallpapers, share your affiliate link and follow your earnings and payouts.

steps.title: Become a creator
steps.body: From Account → Sell your art: enter your creator name, how you want to be paid, your PAN (India) and accept the creator agreement.

steps.title: Your dashboard
steps.body: Your dashboard shows KYC status, your share of each sale (70% by default) and how you get paid.

steps.title: Your affiliate link
steps.body: Add your code to any HirecWallp link. You earn 10% of orders placed within 30 days of a click, paid with your monthly payout.

steps.title: Your submissions
steps.body: Every upload and its status: In review or Live.

steps.title: Upload a wallpaper
steps.body: Add a title, tags and description and pick the file (at least 3840 px on the long edge). We check quality, duplicates and content automatically, then review it.

steps.title: Earnings
steps.body: Earnings are worked out every month from paid sales of your wallpapers, membership downloads and affiliate orders.

steps.title: Payouts
steps.body: Payouts are sent monthly once your KYC is verified. TDS is deducted where the law requires it, and each payout lists it.

chapters.title: The admin dashboard
chapters.summary: What needs your attention, store setup, sales at a glance, and how the admin menu is organised.

steps.title: The admin menu
steps.body: The left menu is grouped: Overview, Sales & customers, Catalogue, Pricing, Marketing and Business. Badges show how many items wait for you.

steps.title: Numbers at a glance
steps.body: Revenue and paid orders for the last 30 days, new customers and how many wallpapers are live.

steps.title: Needs attention
steps.body: Everything waiting on you, most urgent first: overdue support, messages, takedowns, failed jobs, creator submissions and drafts. Click a row to open it.

steps.title: Store setup checklist
steps.body: A checklist of what the store needs before launch — wallpapers, Razorpay keys, business details, grievance officer, store open.

steps.title: Recent orders
steps.body: The latest orders; click one to open it, or All orders for the full list.

steps.title: Analytics
steps.body: Sales by day, top sellers, most viewed wallpapers, the shopping funnel and sales by country.

chapters.title: Adding and managing wallpapers
chapters.summary: Batch upload, duplicate checks, AI-filled details, drafts, publishing and editing.

steps.title: Upload in batches
steps.body: Drop many files at once. Each is checked (size, near-duplicates), resized into every variant and saved as a draft. With “Let AI choose”, the title, description, tags and category are filled in for you.

steps.title: Review drafts
steps.body: Edit title, description, category, tags and Free inline. Cards filled by AI carry an AI badge until you edit them.

steps.title: Publish
steps.body: Tick the drafts to publish and press Save & publish. Save changes keeps them as drafts.

steps.title: Creator submissions
steps.body: Wallpapers uploaded by creators wait here for your review before they go live.

steps.title: The catalogue and bulk actions
steps.body: Search and filter every wallpaper. Select several to publish, unpublish, archive, make free or premium, or change category in one go.

steps.title: Edit a wallpaper
steps.body: Change the title, description, alt text, tags, category, set and Free. Deleting is blocked once a wallpaper has sold (archive it instead).

steps.title: Replace the image
steps.body: Upload a better file or regenerate all sizes. Old files and cached downloads are cleaned up automatically.

chapters.title: Orders, customers and support
chapters.summary: Find orders, refund them, help a customer and answer support requests.

steps.title: Orders
steps.body: Switch between paid, not completed, refunded and failed orders, and search by email, order id or invoice number. Export CSV for your records.

steps.title: Order details and refunds
steps.body: See what was bought, the payment id and receipt. Refund sends the money back through Razorpay and removes what was granted.

steps.title: Help a customer
steps.body: Add or remove credits, gift a wallpaper, change the price country after a move, set the role, or block the account.

steps.title: Support inbox
steps.body: Requests are sorted into Needs reply, Overdue, Waiting on customer and Resolved. Answer within 48 hours; resolve within 30 days.

steps.title: Reply to a request
steps.body: Reply to the customer (they get an email) or add an internal note only staff can see, and set the status.

steps.title: Make it right
steps.body: Fix the problem from the ticket: refund the order, add credits, or restore downloads. Each action is noted in the thread and the activity log.

chapters.title: Prices, plans and growth
chapters.summary: Credit packs, memberships, country tiers and the growth tools.

steps.title: Credit packs
steps.body: Set each pack's credits, bonus credits, price and currency per country tier (or a single country). Optional sale dates make festival offers.

steps.title: Membership plans
steps.body: Create monthly, long-term, category and business plans with a monthly allowance; manage members (add days, add wallpapers, revoke).

steps.title: Pricing by country
steps.body: See which tier each country is in and move a country to another tier. Here you also set the credit value used for creator earnings.

steps.title: Growth tools
steps.body: Today's free wallpaper (run it now if needed), creator affiliate commissions, referrals and gifts — switched on and tuned in Settings → Growth.

chapters.title: Settings, tax and system health
chapters.summary: Store switches, business details, the tax centre, system health and the activity log.

steps.title: Store switches
steps.body: Open or close the store, and switch membership, creator sign-ups, free downloads and the newsletter on or off. Tabs hold business & legal details, growth settings and prices & FX.

steps.title: Announcement bar
steps.body: The message shown at the top of every page, with an optional link.

steps.title: Tax centre
steps.body: Turnover against the GST limit, upcoming filing dates, sales and TDS registers to download, and tax settings. Rules are encoded for you, but have a CA check them.

steps.title: System health
steps.body: Checks the database, storage, payments and email, shows orders waiting for payment confirmation and when each scheduled job last ran.

steps.title: Activity log
steps.body: Every change made in the admin — who did what, and when.
